get_mdf_content: get the MDF map content string for the standard or bi-coastal Diplomacy map
province_name_to_id: build a dictionary mapping Diplomacy province names to their integer IDs from the standard map
province_id_to_home_sc_power: get a dictionary mapping province IDs to their home power index in Diplomacy
build_adjacency: build a province adjacency matrix from MDF content showing army and fleet connections
fleet_adjacency_map: build a mapping of valid fleet movement paths between areas on the bi-coastal map
